Name: Michael, Son of Jehoshaphat
Summary: Michael was a son of Jehoshaphat who received great gifts from his father and was slain by his brother Jehoram.
KeyStory: Jehoshaphat's sons, including Michael, received gifts and fenced cities, but Jehoram slew all his brethren.
RelatedPeople: King Jehoshaphat; Jehoram, King of Judah
LifeLesson: Inheritance without justice is a fragile gift.
